title: Update a copy: add a service description and retain earlier data
goal: Add an optional text service description in a restored copy and verify old requests, the new field and recovery.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 5; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: You need a short service description, not a new platform or a renamed card. Change one structural definition in your copy and verify the new value together with previous requests. The check can detect both a missing new field and damaged old work.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: The worked example uses its own 30/45=75 set. New independent work continues different own 40/25=65 from A5. Do not compare them as one database. Run permission, restoration and upgrade exercises only in a new isolated copy; preserve the original, DT/CFand previous work. Nexus stores the lesson and your note; it does not change external1Croles or data.

sections.title: Platform and solution updates differ
paragraphs: A new executable platform version and a new configuration are different changes. Record both versions, compatibility mode and purpose before and after. Do not blame every error on “old 1C” without reproduction. Start with one configuration change on the same platform to avoid mixing two factors.

Only the configuration changes, on the same platform. Add service УчебноеОписание: String(100), optional. This does not rename Наименование. Keep the A4 customer note and A5 table. Do not load a full new CF over customized work.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: Check the added feature together with previous scenarios.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

sections.title: How to carry out the worked example
paragraphs: Follow the route in your prepared own copy. This is the worked example; the new task below uses different data. Compare each expectation with your actual reread.
Step 1. Use a freshly restored 30/45=75 copy from the DT before the previous edit. Record versions/path/control keys and retain the source. Expected: An exact 75 baseline is identified.
Step 2. Add УчебноеОписание: String, length 100, no fill check. Keep earlier names/types/objects. Expected: One optional field added.
Step 3. Review changes and update only the copy. Stop for removals or unrelated objects. Expected: Field added without deleting prior structure.

Step 4. Find the old service’s empty description, write Учебная проверка A6, save and reopen. Compare service code, requests 30/45, total 75 and retained customer note. Expected: Description persists; references/controls agree.

Step 5. Open the original path or restore the earlier DT into another empty base and compare pre-change controls. Keep the updated copy. Expected: Pre-change state is accessible and new work retained.

sections.title: A control dataset protects meaning
paragraphs: Prepare an old request, a new request, zero duration and rejected input. Reconcile report and references before upgrading. Repeat the same set afterwards and add the new capability’s scenario. Opening the main window is insufficient: lost fields or broken filters may appear only when old data is read.

Record service codes and control-request references / numbers / minutes 30 / 45. Preserve the source and DT. Add one attribute, save configuration, then apply it to the database. The change list must match the new service field; unexpected removals require stopping before application.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: After adding the description the report total matches. Are all previous fields automatically established as preserved?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. An equal total can conceal different records or offsetting errors. Compare previous numbers, references, fields, table and note, then the new text after reopening. Record platform and configuration versions separately.

sections.title: Verify return beforehand
paragraphs: Back up before changing and verify restoration separately. Once an upgrade changes data, replacing the executable alone need not restore earlier state. Keep source and upgraded copies with distinct paths and identities. Preserve failed copies until the cause and safe protocol have been recorded.

The old service’s new field starts empty. Write Учебная проверка A6 and reopen. Earlier references and 75 should remain. If using the already changed 90-minute copy, explicitly record 90 as its baseline; comparing different initial states does not establish update preservation.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Use the second worked case to identify the unsafe or unproved condition. Never perform destructive restoration over existing work.
Record both versions and change one factor per experiment.

sections.title: Apply based on results
paragraphs: The summary lists passed, failed and untested workflows plus rollback. Untested exchange or permissions do not inherit PASS from unrelated checks. The teaching task delivers a tested candidate rather than publishing it. Real working-system changes require their owner and an agreed maintenance window even after successful tests.

Prepare recovery before modifying: retained source and a verified DT. Loading an earlier CF does not guarantee reverting data after structural changes. Open the preserved source or restore its DT into another new base and compare controls. This exercise authorizes no production publication.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: In your restored copy add optional УчебноеОписание: String 100 to Услуги. Verify a field from your existing attempt rather than duplicating it. For the new service from independent A5 work check its initially empty value, save “Самостоятельное описание A6” and reread the same code. Compare all previous fields, A4 note and A5 rows. If the backup lesson already changed the copy, compare against its 75 rather than original 65; adding the description does not change the total.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

No working users were used; the complete manual window sequence was not checked. An author capture does not establish completion of your task.

options: No: compare keys and fields separately
selfcheck.feedback: No. An equal total can conceal different records or offsetting errors. Compare previous numbers, references, fields, table and note, then the new text after reopening. Record platform and configuration versions separately.
The change must match the intended scope.
A new interface alone does not establish preservation.

selfcheck.prompt: Should adding the service description change old request minutes?
options: No: compare the same current set
Yes: a new field changes the total automatically
selfcheck.feedback: I retained the service code and added only an optional 100-character string attribute. Initially the new description is empty; after saving and reopening it reads “Самостоятельное описание A6”. Other services are empty in this new field. Request identities and fields, A4 note and A5 rows persist; the same control matches before/after the description. Saving the definition, updating the database and saving a card are three distinct actions. Preserve the original and verifiedDT as a separate return point.
